races.name: Sebden Steel Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
An interesting opener. A big-field bumper win at the spring festival here marks down DELAMOTTE as one who can do well over hurdles for his top stable. Kingstonian rates an obvious danger after 2 good placed efforts since switched to hurdles. Brady Hartsfield and Bacharach should have more to offer on the back of promising hurdle debuts. Point recruit Menethil is the mount of Jack Kennedy from the Gordon Elliott quintet.

  1. DELAMOTTE (FR)
  2. KINGSTONIAN
  3. BRADY HARTSFIELD (IRE)

races.name: Conway Piling Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
After only the 2 outings over hurdles, MIGHTY PARK looks an exciting prospect for chasing and starts off in a race in which Willie Mullins tends to introduce one of his better novices, Gaelic Warrior landing the prize in 2023. He gets the vote ahead of stablemate Saint Baco, with Fierce Handay and Powerful others to consider.

  1. MIGHTY PARK (IRE)
  2. SAINT BACO (FR)
  3. FIERCE HANDAY (IRE)

races.name: Boodles Florida Pearl Novice Chase (Grade 2)
races.verdict:
KISS WILL remains a maiden over fences but sets the standard on the pick of last season's form and should prove hard to beat if returning near that level. Ballygunner Castle is feared most back in novice company after improving to land a notable handicap last time, while The Big Clubman is also respected stepped back up in trip.

  1. KISS WILL (FR)
  2. BALLYGUNNER CASTLE (IRE)
  3. THE BIG CLUBMAN (IRE)

races.name: Ryans Cleaning Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
PREDATORS GOLD likely would have won a Grade 1 novice last season but for a late mishap and, with Paul Townend keeping the faith, is taken to make a successful handicap debut. Letos is feared most despite being out of the weights given how well treated he looks on last season's hurdles form, while Argento Boy may need a stiffer test but appeals for minor honours.

  1. PREDATORS GOLD (FR)
  2. LETOS (FR)
  3. ARGENTO BOY (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Morgiana Hurdle (Grade 1)
races.verdict:
A dominant winner of a 4-runner renewal of this race last year, high-class LOSSIEMOUTH should have no trouble repeating the feat. William Munny ought to prove best of the rest.

  1. LOSSIEMOUTH (FR)
  2. WILLIAM MUNNY (IRE)
  3. EBONY KING (IRE)

races.name: Total Event Rental 3-Y-O Hurdle
races.verdict:
MOMENTUM OF LOVE arrives on the back of a hurdling success in France and is expected to maintain her unbeaten record now starting out for powerful connections. Danny Power has taken well to hurdling and is feared most, while newcomer Rio de La Pampa is also one to consider for a yard known for unearthing promising recruits.

  1. MOMENTUM OF LOVE (FR)
  2. DANNY POWER (IRE)
  3. RIO DE LA PAMPA (FR)

races.name: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series At Punchestown Festival 2027 Qualifier Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
THANKYOUFORTHEDAYS showed improved form when winning last season and returns from a summer break still relatively unexposed. The longer trip should play to his strengths and he's taken to make a winning return. Tangara Bay is on the comeback trail but represents a yard in red-hot form and is feared most after just a handful of starts, while both Jacovec Cavern and Sonny May are respected.

  1. THANKYOUFORTHEDAYS (IRE)
  2. TANGARA BAY (FR)
  3. JACOVEC CAVERN

races.name: WTW Willis (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
MISTER BOUM ran out an easy winner of his sole start in points and makes plenty of appeal on his Rules debut having joined all-conquering yard. Chanson du Jury is another fascinating contender having changed hands for big money on the back of a point success, while Ifuknowuknow is a likeable sort who should give his running once again.

  1. MISTER BOUM (FR)
  2. CHANSON DU JURY (IRE)
  3. IFUKNOWUKNOW (IRE)

races.name: Ascot Shared Ownership Weekend Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
THE WALK made a taking start to his hurdling career at Ffos Las a month ago and bred to stay well, he can improve for this step up in trip and repeat the feat of a year ago and win at this meeting again. Point recruit Vedivici may offer most resistance, ahead of Katarcice.

  1. THE WALK (IRE)
  2. VEDIVICI (FR)
  3. KATARCICE (FR)

races.name: Ladbrokes 1965 Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
STEEL ALLY may have more to offer up in trip this season and makes the most appeal hailing from a yard that does well with reappearing runners. Master Chewy made an encouraging return at Aintree and is the pick for the forecast.

  1. STEEL ALLY (FR)
  2. MASTER CHEWY (IRE)
  3. BLOW YOUR WAD (IRE)

races.name: Ladbrokes Ascot Hurdle (Grade 2) (Registered As The Ascot Hurdle) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KATEIRA showed she retains plenty of speed when scoring at Wetherby last time, and Dan Skelton's smashing mare can gain a deserved first success in Grade 2 company. Lucky Place is most likely to get the run of things and may edge Altobelli for second.

  1. KATEIRA
  2. LUCKY PLACE (FR)
  3. ALTOBELLI (IRE)

races.name: Ladbrokes Get Your Free Racing Bet Today Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
PORTER IN THE PARK is lurking on a dangerous mark and can go 2 places better than in last year's renewal of this race. The main danger could be Easy Love, who is relatively unexposed in handicaps, while That's Nice is entitled to be in the mix if on another going day. Likeable mare Love of Neymore deserves an honourable mention in an open-looking event.

  1. PORTER IN THE PARK (IRE)
  2. EASY LOVE (IRE)
  3. THAT'S NICE (IRE)

races.name: Restorations UK Berkshire National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
OUR POWER confirmed that he still has lots to offer when only narrowly denied at Sandown to end last season and he remains 1 lb below his last winning mark. He can pick up where he left off to return to winning ways, though Rock My Way isn't taken lightly in his bid to land this prize for the second year running. Mt Fugi Park completes the shortlist.

  1. OUR POWER (IRE)
  2. ROCK MY WAY (IRE)
  3. MT FUGI PARK (IRE)

races.name: Vietti Barolo Hurst Park Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
VANDERPOEL took his form up to a smart level when making a successful return over C&D 3 weeks ago and, with further improvement likely in his second season over fences, he is fancied to follow up. Shakeyatailfeather is feared most with conditions promising to suit, while Calico also gives Dan Skelton a strong hand.

  1. VANDERPOEL (IRE)
  2. SHAKEYATAILFEATHER (IRE)
  3. CALICO (GER)

races.name: Ascot Advent Calendar Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for HERBYGOESBANANAS, who opened his hurdles account in good style at Worcester at the beginning of the month. He gets the vote ahead of handicap debutant Baile An Or, with Mr Rafiki another to consider arriving on the back of a breakthrough victory.

  1. HERBYGOESBANANAS
  2. BAILE AN OR (IRE)
  3. MR RAFIKI (IRE)

races.name: Betfair Exchange Graduation Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KOKTAIL DIVIN was one of the leading novice chasers of last season and could be a cut above his 2 rivals. Be Aware should follow him home assuming his stamina holds over the longest trip he's tackled.

  1. KOKTAIL DIVIN (FR)
  2. BE AWARE (FR)
  3. LEAVE OF ABSENCE (FR)

races.name: Bet At Your Best With Betfair Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KYKOROCK readily brushed aside a couple of subsequent winners when making it 4 wins from 5 starts over fences on his return at Worcester, so there's every chance he can defy another rise. Tigers Moon and We're Red And Blue both offered plenty to work on when starting out in this sphere recently and look the main threats.

  1. KYKOROCK (FR)
  2. TIGERS MOON
  3. WE'RE RED AND BLUE

races.name: Betfair Supports Safer Gambling Week Newton Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
COSMIC CONNECTION looks well worth another chance to build on his promising novice season. He gets the nod over North Shore and Saint Jeannais, who have both created favourable impressions, while Spanish Darling and Hold The Throw could outrun their forecast odds under speed-favouring conditions.

  1. COSMIC CONNECTION (IRE)
  2. NORTH SHORE (FR)
  3. SAINT JEANNAIS (FR)

races.name: Best Odds On The Betfair Exchange Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KOCKTAIL BLEU looks the one to beat following his encouraging fourth in a loaded renewal of the Silver Trophy on return. Give It To Me Oj stands out as the main danger ahead of Smokeringinthedark, who was progressing steadily when runner-up here in the spring.

  1. KOCKTAIL BLEU (FR)
  2. GIVE IT TO ME OJ
  3. SMOKERINGINTHEDARK (IRE)

races.name: Betfair Stayers' Red Rose Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Improving 5-y-o SEANIECON can make light of a 6 lb rise for Cheltenham and continue the O'Neill stable's good recent record in valuable handicap hurdles. Matty's Getaway is another handicapper on the up and he may provide the chief threat ahead of last year's second/third Hartington and Phantomofthepoints.

  1. SEANIECON (IRE)
  2. MATTY'S GETAWAY (IRE)
  3. HARTINGTON (IRE)

races.name: Betfair Chase (Grade 1) (Registered As The Lancashire Chase) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GREY DAWNING can emulate Kauto Star, Cue Card, Bristol de Mai and Royale Pagaille and become the fifth back-to-back winner of this race. Like the selection, Affordale Fury has a good record fresh and last season's Savills winner can give Dan Skelton's charge most to do. Jagwar, who retains the cheekpieces he wore for the first time in the Grand National, looks best of the remainder.

  1. GREY DAWNING (IRE)
  2. AFFORDALE FURY (IRE)
  3. JAGWAR (FR)

races.name: Betfair Backs Opinions Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SALADINS SON finished runner-up in this corresponding event 12 months ago and can go one better in what looks a weaker renewal. Dexperts Opinion has made a bright start for the Bowen yard and looks the danger with the form of his Durham National second having been boosted.

  1. SALADINS SON (IRE)
  2. DEXPERTS OPINION (IRE)
  3. CAUGHTINYOURTRANCE (IRE)

races.name: Podkovan Won By A Czech Head Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for expensive point recruit LASTBUTNOTLEASED to make a winning start for Nicky Henderson. Kaldoun des Rocs and Master Roque head the dangers in an ordinary maiden.

  1. LASTBUTNOTLEASED (IRE)
  2. KALDOUN DES ROCS (FR)
  3. MASTER ROQUE (FR)

races.name: Podkovan Dancing Through The Dark Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The one who appeals most is the lightly raced THAT IS BLUE, who is heading in the right direction and promises to be well suited by the increase in trip. Daaris and Alan Bresil head the opposition.

  1. THAT IS BLUE (IRE)
  2. DAARIS (IRE)
  3. ALAN BRESIL

races.name: Moment For The Monastery Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not the easiest race to assess but REALTA LIATH has a good record fresh and is also well handicapped on her Fontwell chasing debut win so gets the vote. Chasing newcomers Livingonaprayer and Crazierthandaisy bring potential and are in excellent hands so could emerge as the main dangers, especially if the betting speaks in their favour.

  1. REALTA LIATH (IRE)
  2. LIVINGONAPRAYER
  3. CRAZIERTHANDAISY

races.name: Prancing To The Pilsner Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NORTH OF RICHMOND put a disappointing handicap debut behind him when scoring at Newcastle on his reappearance and it's reasonable to assume he could have further improvement in the pipeline given his lightly-raced profile, so a 2 lb higher mark looks well within his compass. Virtual Rock is thriving for his current yard and shouldn't be inconvenienced by the return to 2m given how he goes through his races, with Caelan completing the shortlist.

  1. NORTH OF RICHMOND (IRE)
  2. VIRTUAL ROCK (IRE)
  3. CAELAN (IRE)

races.name: Podkovan Zero To Hero Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
CHOSEN HERO, like many before her, was much improved for the switch to James Owen when a comfortable hurdles scorer at Lingfield recently and is taken to follow up reverted to fences off a still handy-looking mark. Walk The Plank has been in excellent nick since the cheekpieces went on and rates the main danger, although course specialist Cloudy Wednesday and C&D scorer Helios Allen can also play a prominent role.

  1. CHOSEN HERO (IRE)
  2. WALK THE PLANK (IRE)
  3. CLOUDY WEDNESDAY (IRE)

races.name: Podkovans Last Orders 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Newcomer TOOK YOU TWO makes appeal on breeding for this type of race, so he’s put forward as the suggestion before market clues. Nostrae De Cougny quickened well to account for Annies Pass on his debut at Market Rasen and could uphold the form under a penalty. Snicket wasn’t seen to best effect in a muddling race over C&D last month and is also considered.

  1. TOOK YOU TWO
  2. NOSTRAE DE COUGNY (FR)
  3. ANNIES PASS

races.name: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
races.verdict:
HONEY DALE is fancied to make it 2-2 for the Charlie Clover/Billy Loughnane combination. Heated Moment and Labiche head the dangers.

  1. HONEY DALE (IRE)
  2. HEATED MOMENT
  3. LABICHE

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Those with experience do not set a high standard so newcomers may come to the fore. Before market clues, EL MUTAMAKEN, Al Lazzaz and Aziz Malak are preferred in that order.

  1. EL MUTAMAKEN (IRE)
  2. AL LAZZAZ (IRE)
  3. AZIZ MALAK (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for BIBURY STAR, who caught the eye finishing well on his recent debut at Wolverhampton. I Know You By Now should improve on his opening effort at Newmarket, while expensive yearling Vallejo shouldn't be totally discounted given he hails from a stable whose runners can improve markedly on their second starts.

  1. BIBURY STAR (IRE)
  2. I KNOW YOU BY NOW (IRE)
  3. VALLEJO (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
IRIS OLIVIA holds the clear edge on form and is taken to make a winning start for Charlie Clover at the chief expense of Nottingham runner-up Crimson Blaze. Newcomers Romantic Pursuit and Virago Parvenue are in good hands and could also play a part, especially if the market speaks in their favour.

  1. IRIS OLIVIA (IRE)
  2. CRIMSON BLAZE
  3. ROMANTIC PURSUIT (IRE)

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but MR NUGGET signalled he is ready to strike again when a recent runner-up at Wolverhampton and can go one better off the same mark here. Cancan In The Rain wasn't seen to ideal effect when fifth at Kempton last time and could emerge as the main threat off an easing mark, although Celestias Comet and Fallacious Promise also need factoring into this very open handicap.

  1. MR NUGGET
  2. CANCAN IN THE RAIN (IRE)
  3. CELESTIAS COMET (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict:
TAN RAPIDO won at this course in July and has returned from a break with solid efforts at Wolverhampton, including when shaping better than the bare result latest. Hucklesbrook looks well handicapped now, while Kiniro returns to this C&D, where he's twice a winner, and is worth another chance after his stalls mishap last time.

  1. TAN RAPIDO
  2. HUCKLESBROOK
  3. KINIRO

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
FUSEBOARD won back-to-back races in the summer, the second over C&D in August in what looks strong form, and can complete a hat-trick on return from a 93-day break. Thriving 5-timer seeker Macarone looks a big threat, while Yachtsman is one of many to have slipped to a workable mark.

  1. FUSEBOARD
  2. MACARONE
  3. YACHTSMAN

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
THE ANTHONY GOVER won twice at Wolverhampton over 9.5f in September and has held form well since so he's bound to be bang there if coping with the drop back in trip and different track. Musical Soldier is also proving most consistent and can be his biggest threat.

  1. THE ANTHONY GOVER
  2. MUSICAL SOLDIER (IRE)
  3. VICTORY SOUND (IRE)

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
races.verdict:
BRAVE LEADER won with plenty in hand on stable debut last month and looks the type to prove prolific this winter, so he's taken to follow up. Off Spin has discovered the winning knack of late and is feared most if proving as effective on all-weather, while Tortured Soul warrants a second look with much more in his favour.

  1. BRAVE LEADER
  2. OFF SPIN (IRE)
  3. TORTURED SOUL

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MR MOONSHINE went like the best horse at the weights when runner-up at Southwell on his most recent outing, doing all he could from a hopeless position, and is plainly one to be interested in again. Fleur de Mer arrives in good order and heads up the opposition, along with Annandale, who could easily get back on track resuming from another break.

  1. MR MOONSHINE (IRE)
  2. FLEUR DE MER (IRE)
  3. ANNANDALE (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
KARTINI still looks well treated on the pick of her form and can make it 2 wins from her last 3 starts. Class-dropper Humble Spark is feared most, with Rory's Gold and Regalian others to consider.

  1. KARTINI (IRE)
  2. HUMBLE SPARK (IRE)
  3. RORY'S GOLD (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
All-Weather Championship Is Back Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BONDY BOY produced a promising first effort when runner-up on his recent debut at Southwell and should take plenty of beating with improvement on the cards. Maharry is the narrow pick of the 3 newcomers before market clues.

  1. BONDY BOY
  2. MAHARRY (IRE)
  3. MAIDEN'S BOWER (USA)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict:
EAGLE STORM is drawn higher than ideal but looks open to further progress and can defy a 4 lb rise gained for making a winning nursery debut here. Court Legend has made a positive start in nurseries and remains with potential at this trip, whilst Benedetti should benefit for the step up to 1m on her first start in this company.

  1. EAGLE STORM
  2. COURT LEGEND
  3. BENEDETTI

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CORNICHON sets a good standard here on the basis of his 2 in-frame efforts and he's taken to get off the mark. The well-bred Debutante went with much promise dropped to this trip at Nottingham last time and she's the main threat, with Kalahari Flame perhaps completing the 1-2-3.

  1. CORNICHON (FR)
  2. DEBUTANTE
  3. KALAHARI FLAME

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
AURADUE has fewer miles on the clock than her opposition here and she can defy a 4 lb rise to follow up from last month's Southwell success. Pivotal Terms went down by just a neck there and is respected meeting the selection on better terms, whilst Spun To Gold is interesting from this mark on his second outing after a break.

  1. AURADUE
  2. PIVOTAL TERMS
  3. SPUN TO GOLD (USA)

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
races.verdict:
OPPENHEIMER has the air of one who could continue to improve for the James Owen yard and he can maintain his unbeaten start for his new trainer. Our Dagger and Titainium both arrive after promising efforts and can pose the main threats.

  1. OPPENHEIMER (IRE)
  2. OUR DAGGER (IRE)
  3. TITAINIUM

races.name: All-Weather Championship Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict:
OXFORD CIRCUS is really starting to find his feet for this yard and looks up to completing a hat-trick. Ice Show is worth another chance having shown improved form to score over C&D 2 starts back and is next best ahead of Kit Gabriel, who drops into a 0-65 for the first time.

  1. OXFORD CIRCUS (IRE)
  2. ICE SHOW
  3. KIT GABRIEL (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict:
ROARING RALPH could be worth chancing off his reduced mark in a wide-open finale. Showtime Mahomes was quickly back to form returned to all-weather last time and is second choice ahead of Too Much, who was just edged out over C&D at the same meeting.

  1. ROARING RALPH
  2. SHOWTIME MAHOMES
  3. TOO MUCH
